punchline: Executives on afternoon earnings calls sounded more irritable and combative than on morning calls, and share prices noticed.
thirty_sec: Daniel Pink starts with a study of 500 million tweets: across the world, mood peaks in the morning, dips in the afternoon and recovers in the evening. Even company earnings calls get more combative after lunch. His takeaway: put analytic work at your peak, and save insight work for when you're a little tired, because a looser mind makes odd connections.
